message.content: According to the group discussion, the match against Manchester City in 2022 was particularly notable for its stoppage-time comeback goal. Specifically, JakeWatson shared that the match featured a stoppage-time goal by Rodrygo, which allowed Manchester City to score two goals in quick succession. This comeback demonstrated the resilience and determination of the Real Madrid team, highlighting their "never-say-die" attitude. The match was described as "pure drama," with the narrative shifting significantly after the stoppage-time goal. This comeback was seen as a testament to the team's ability to stay calm and make crucial decisions under pressure, showcasing their strong performance and tenacity.
